list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 hidden until earned. No online trophies. Trophy names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, cross-checked November 2026); every guide below is written in our own words and cites its sources.
rebuilt: 2026-11-20 — rebuilt under a live make.fun recording for the strict-transcripts resubmission. Data re-verified: 55 trophies, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze, 28 hidden, every guide non-blank. Three internal inconsistencies fixed in this pass: the final-mission chapter (it contradicted the Chapter 5 mission), and Andy's quest count (the named quests did not add up to 5).

sixshore.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

exophase.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions and grades as listed on PSN)

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions and grades as listed on PSN)

roadmap.title: Play the story (Chapters 1–5)
roadmap.text: Finish all five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Every story trophy pops automatically; none can be missed. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before Chapter 1 ends (see Positive Mental Attitude). Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars as you go — progress already counts toward the 100% checklist. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game+. Never turn on a cheat: cheats disable trophies and saving. Source: PowerPyx roadmap.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion checklist + challenges
roadmap.text: After the credits, the 100% checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks, 100 optional missions and 15 of 18 meditation spots. Most of it falls out of the other trophies. Source: PowerPyx roadmap and 100% guide.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands (they are not part of 100%), the character questlines, the remaining misc trophies and the money trophies. Everything is still available in free-roam after the story. The platinum pops when the last trophy does. Source: PowerPyx roadmap.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — no multiplayer and no DLC required. Expect roughly 200 hours in total, most of it on the 100% completion checklist rather than the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; PlanetGTA6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the first mission of the game. It cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 1 ends, after you finish its final mission and start Chapter 2. Before that point, do the one missable meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the only thing in Chapter 1 that can pass you by. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, after its final mission. From Chapter 2 on you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which opens the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best) and the last meditation spots. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 3 ends. Chapter 3 is where the big robbery systems unlock — Yasmani's jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner and Randy's car list — so the robbery trophies start opening up from here. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 4 ends, after its final main mission. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and one of only two golds. Finish the final mission (Starting From Zero) and the credits roll; free-roam and the 100% checklist open up afterwards. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. It cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It cannot be missed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the second gold. Open the checklist after the story at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is forgiving — about 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks and 15 of 18 meditation spots. Nothing toward it is missable and everything can be done in free-roam. Most of it completes itself while you chase the other trophies. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide and 100% guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps). Mix categories and pick the quickest — flying under bridges is the fastest. For 100% you need 300, so keep going past the trophy. Track progress by region at Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them at Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most unlock naturally while working on the other trophies; the story introduces most of them for you. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The challenges are short time trials; raising your Focus level (by playing ranges, golf, pool, fishing and landing headshots) makes the later ones easier. You only need 70 of 80 challenges for 100%, but every range gold is required here. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations (42 races in total). Fly the drone through the checkpoints faster than the rival time. These also count toward the 100% checklist, so they are not optional. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations around Leonida. Any 20 count — car races, race challenges and drone races all feed the activity tracker. Pick the short street circuits first and repeat the ones you are comfortable with only counts once per location, so keep moving to new spots. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets. Fishing also feeds the Focus stat and the activity tracker. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once — no need to beat every challenge. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. Finish her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams. He calls, then waits at his shop in Key Lento (green KR icon). He marks shipwreck treasure spots on the map — dive with the metal detector, dig up the treasure and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his quest sets. He goes quiet for a stretch of the story, but comes back in Chapter 2–3, so nothing is missable. Track it at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last one. All of them stay available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Only certain questlines count — the big character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do not. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing mentor) and Pilot Pete (package deliveries). Watch the trophy tracker for your count, and keep playing stranger quests in free-roam until it hits 8. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wishlist unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him with the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, steal it and drive it back — good condition pays more. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Deliver all 16 and the trophy pops. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City — destroy enough of them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down. Finish it and the trophy pops. Everything stays available after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; each spot counts once per character, so do it with both Jason and Lucia for +2 per spot. Track them at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The Chapter 1 meditation is the risk: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. That spot vanishes after Chapter 1 and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, so do it to be safe. The last spots need both characters playable together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). For 100% only 15 of 18 are needed. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide; OutputLag trophy list.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His quests send you after animals he requests — hunt them, bring them back to Bret. The first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more. Track the hunts at Map > Activities > Target Deck; all 15 decks are also needed for 100%. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets scattered around Leonida; each set is a handful of cards, and you only need 3 full sets for the trophy. Cards turn up in shops, houses and out in the world — pick up every card you pass and check the collection menu to see which sets are nearly done. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan): any mix of the 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags counts, and there are more than 100 in total. Scanning also feeds Whip It Good (vehicles) and the 100% checklist, so scan everything you walk past. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (8 categories of 10). Track them at Progress > Challenges. Most complete themselves while you work on the other trophies; for 100% you need 70, so this pops on the way. When you are nearly done, pick the easiest remaining challenges from the list. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters together, so earliest is after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then build a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. The easy route: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Needs your partner beside you (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). Rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level never drops — loot a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, once Yasmani's jewelry jobs (Chapter 3) have unlocked them. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 of the 557 vehicles at launch. Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes as they pass — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. A busy road in Vice City fills the list fast. For 100% you need 200 base-model vehicles, so this pops on the way. Track it at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak points light up. Drop 5 enemies in one use. It only lasts a few seconds, so prepare: eat or drink to top up Focus, take Adrenaline to stretch it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up a group at a gang operation and fire without missing. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Higher Focus levels (raised by ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots) make it easier. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — the ones on the open airfield do not count. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and fire at enemies until the trophy pops. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry stores with green icons. Enter a store through the back door with the Snap Gun (not by kicking it), find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe without tripping the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Unlock bank vaults with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash — bring your partner and hand off a bag (hold Right). After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip (after his Payday Loans quests). Robbing a vault gives an instant 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to break the trail. Any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs count, but 100% needs all 8, so this pops on the way. Each vault pays up to $205,000. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…) also counts: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it early: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is entirely visible. You will clear most of it naturally while travelling for missions and collectibles. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total). They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. One per gang is enough for the trophy, but 100% needs all 39. Track each gang's count at Progress > Gangs. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet (PowerPyx lists it as unknown). The description points at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail at a beachfront bar in Ocean Beach and try the spots with a sea view. We will update this guide when a source confirms the spot. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (unknown); PlanetGTA6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS) to break into it. Only this blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed; keep driving away from the showroom. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab what is left — not missable. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). It only works once you can switch between both characters (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2). Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership, filter for clubs on Map > Activities — and always bring your partner (hold Right, press Triangle): while one character trains, the other trains too, so progress doubles. You can also work out at home after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and watch for the demon-face icon: stealthy robberies and clean escapes build a Professional profile, knocking enemies out builds Hardened, killing builds Violent, mass killing builds Psycho, and extreme violence can lock you into the permanent Irredeemable profile (avoid it — cops shoot on sight). It fills up passively through robberies and fights; if it is last, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — PowerPyx lists it as unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The name suggests failing something once, then succeeding on the second try. Try the Payday Loans robbery a second time after an earlier failed attempt, and check the trophy tracker. We will update this guide when a source confirms the trigger. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (unknown); PlanetGTA6 trophy list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods next to it to find the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside and the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — PowerPyx lists it as unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by). Try it on a motorcycle: ride past enemies and use the melee kick attack to knock them down, and repeat until it pops. We will update this guide when a source confirms the exact requirement. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (unknown); PlanetGTA6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while doing the 8 vaults for 100%. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive, so they are the fastest way to reach the total — Ammu-Nations, mod shops and tattoo studios all count, as do clothing, footwear, hair and electronics stores. It accumulates across the whole playthrough. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count) for a total of $160,000, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses). Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 — are the quickest way to fund them. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots to register vehicles. Then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.
